description: 多益進階單字庫 — 鎖定 Part 5/6/7 中高難度字彙、片語動詞、商用英文，App 與 LINE 每日推播共用同一份資料。

meta.source: curated for Jo's TOEIC re-take (845 -> aiming for full score, 990/満点)

words.meaning_zh: 一絲不苟的、非常仔細的
words.example_en: She is meticulous about checking every clause in the contract.
words.example_zh: 她對合約中的每一條款都仔細檢查。

words.example_en: There is a discrepancy between the invoice and the purchase order.
words.example_zh: 發票和採購單之間有出入。

words.example_en: The bonus is contingent on meeting quarterly targets.
words.example_zh: 獎金取決於是否達成季度目標。

words.example_en: The new software will streamline our ordering process.
words.example_zh: 新軟體將簡化我們的訂購流程。

words.example_en: The company decided to outsource its customer service.
words.example_zh: 公司決定將客服外包。

words.example_en: All employees must comply with the new safety regulations.
words.example_zh: 所有員工都必須遵守新的安全規定。

words.example_en: Heavy traffic impeded the delivery schedule.
words.example_zh: 交通壅塞阻礙了送貨時程。

words.example_en: Remote work has become prevalent in recent years.
words.example_zh: 近年來遠端工作已變得相當普遍。

words.example_en: The company will reimburse you for travel expenses.
words.example_zh: 公司會報銷你的差旅費用。

words.example_en: The firm's Asian subsidiary reported record profits.
words.example_zh: 該公司的亞洲子公司公佈了創紀錄的利潤。

words.example_en: The meeting has been deferred until next Monday.
words.example_zh: 會議已延期至下週一。

words.example_en: Please expedite the shipment as the client needs it urgently.
words.example_zh: 請加快出貨,客戶急需這批貨。

words.example_en: Staff may take a day off in lieu of overtime pay.
words.example_zh: 員工可以用休假代替加班費。

words.example_en: The company faced unprecedented demand this quarter.
words.example_zh: 公司本季面臨前所未有的需求。

words.example_en: We need a viable alternative to the current supplier.
words.example_zh: 我們需要一個可行的替代供應商方案。

words.example_en: The board endorsed the new marketing strategy.
words.example_zh: 董事會認可了新的行銷策略。

words.example_en: The old model will be phased out by next year.
words.example_zh: 舊型號明年將被逐步淘汰。

words.example_en: The team will carry out a survey next week.
words.example_zh: 團隊下週將進行一項調查。

words.example_en: We are looking into the cause of the delay.
words.example_zh: 我們正在調查延誤的原因。

words.example_en: Let's hold off on the decision until we get more data.
words.example_zh: 在拿到更多數據前,我們先暫緩這個決定。

words.example_en: The factory follows stringent quality control standards.
words.example_zh: 工廠遵循嚴格的品管標準。

words.example_en: The instructions in the manual are ambiguous.
words.example_zh: 手冊中的說明含糊不清。

words.example_en: The budget was allocated to three departments.
words.example_zh: 預算被分配給三個部門。

words.example_en: The two offices will be consolidated into one.
words.example_zh: 兩間辦公室將整合成一間。

words.example_en: Our sales figures are on par with last year's.
words.example_zh: 我們的銷售數字與去年持平。

words.example_en: Please notify us of any changes in advance.
words.example_zh: 如有任何變動,請提前通知我們。

words.example_en: It is not feasible to finish the project by Friday.
words.example_zh: 在星期五前完成這個專案並不可行。

words.example_en: We need to address the underlying cause of the problem.
words.example_zh: 我們需要處理這個問題的根本原因。

words.example_en: Applicants must be proficient in English and Japanese.
words.example_zh: 應徵者必須精通英文和日文。

words.example_en: The company plans to leverage its brand reputation.
words.example_zh: 公司計畫善用其品牌聲譽。

words.meaning_zh: 令人信服的、引人入勝的
words.example_en: She gave a compelling presentation to investors.
words.example_zh: 她向投資人做了一場極具說服力的簡報。

words.example_en: Please reply at your earliest convenience.
words.example_zh: 請盡快回覆。

words.example_en: The manager has discretion over how the budget is spent.
words.example_zh: 經理有權自行決定預算如何使用。

words.example_en: I am writing on behalf of the sales department.
words.example_zh: 我代表業務部門寫這封信。

words.example_en: All contractors must adhere to the safety guidelines.
words.example_zh: 所有承包商都必須遵守安全準則。

words.example_en: The company's annual turnover exceeded expectations.
words.example_zh: 公司年度營業額超出預期。

words.example_en: The firm decided to cut back on unnecessary expenses.
words.example_zh: 公司決定削減不必要的開支。

words.example_en: The team came up with a creative solution.
words.example_zh: 團隊想出了一個有創意的解決方案。

words.example_en: The project has fallen behind schedule.
words.example_zh: 這個專案已經落後進度了。

words.example_en: The new policy will be rolled out next month.
words.example_zh: 新政策將於下個月推出。

words.example_en: The report was meticulously researched.
words.example_zh: 這份報告的研究做得非常仔細。

words.example_en: This equipment will soon become obsolete.
words.example_zh: 這台設備很快就會過時。

words.example_en: A valid certificate is a prerequisite for the position.
words.example_zh: 有效證照是這個職位的必要條件。

words.example_en: The refund was issued in accordance with company policy.
words.example_zh: 退款是依照公司政策發放的。

words.example_en: Auditors will scrutinize the financial statements.
words.example_zh: 審計人員將仔細審查財務報表。

words.meaning_zh: 多才多藝的、用途廣泛的
words.example_en: This software is versatile enough for both small and large businesses.
words.example_zh: 這套軟體用途廣泛,大小公司都適用。

words.example_en: The company is at the forefront of green technology.
words.example_zh: 該公司走在綠色科技的最前端。

words.example_en: The team attained its sales target ahead of schedule.
words.example_zh: 團隊提前達成了銷售目標。

words.example_en: They found a way to circumvent the shipping delay.
words.example_zh: 他們找到方法規避運送延誤的問題。

words.example_en: The company struggled to keep up with demand.
words.example_zh: 公司很難跟上市場需求。
